items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17
items.q: Deborah Brown is just two blocks away on Turn T. And so I asked her. She came and danced for us.

ctx.x: Oh, I've always wanted to meet him. I never have met him. Oh, my.

Right on the next corner here. Very nice. He's on Sager and Ed Johnson. The next corner. And he plays for Deborah. And, well, he played for it. He went to school with my husband, huh? Oceola went to school with you. And so we mentioned about him playing for the tea. And some of the members says, Oceola Blanchett. I say, sure, why? He says, oh, he's a professor. He wouldn't give no time for a tea. You know, he's always so busy. I says, I'll bet you I can get him. So then I told my husband, he says, let them talk.…
No, there are two good singers. We had one singer. Martha Saison. Martha Saison, that's right.
